observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon DSLR body with “Canon” branding and “800D” marking on the right side; lens appears to be an 18-55mm type (text on lens barrel is partially visible).
Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with a visible screen and buttons; no clear model number on the back.
Photo 2 shows the front/side with “Canon” and “EOS 800D” marking clearly visible; lens front cap is on.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Canon EOS 800D marking is visible on photo 0 and photo 2; lens appears to be the common 18-55mm kit type, but the exact “18-55mm” text is not fully readable in the provided images.
Photos show “Canon” and “EOS 800D” on the camera body (photo 0 and photo 2), not Sony.

risks.risk: Lens exact model/range not fully verifiable from photos (18-55mm text not clearly readable).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the lens barrel showing the full focal length text (e.g., “18-55mm”) and mount details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic kit lens / worst-case mismatch (still treat as DSLR kit but not assume exact 18-55mm).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (shutter count, autofocus, buttons, and screen performance not shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a nearby object, and a short recording/playback clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case (assume needs checking).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible (sensor dust, lens fungus/haze, scratches, or battery/charger health).
risks.proof: Ask for: (1) a photo of the sensor at f/22 (dust test) and (2) a clear photo of lens glass against light for haze/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition with possible minor issues.

risks.risk: Missing accessories not shown (battery, charger, strap, memory card).
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo of everything included (battery model, charger, cables, strap, lens caps).
risks.if_unproven: Price as body+lens only (no extras assumed).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the lens barrel showing the exact focal length text (confirm 18-55mm).
Video proof: power on → menu → autofocus on a subject → take 3 photos → playback.
Sensor dust test photo (shoot a blank white wall at high f-number) and lens glass check against light.
Photo of all included items laid out (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card if any).
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Canon EOS 800D, but key items that determine the real market price in Rivers (exact lens spec, full functionality, and included accessories) are not fully provable from the provided images.
